purpose: Test common/local/volume risk-factor recovery with a public multi-context design.
selection: For each public context, select 16 rows by deterministic QR column pivoting on the nine public physical-risk exposure columns; no source or target outcomes are used.
promotion_rule: Do not use the heldout confirmation block unless the geometry gate passes and the development block has finite factor estimates, no false certificates, and a predeclared paired risk decision comparison.
negative_evidence: The original 16-row single-context risk design and all previous physical-risk failures remain unchanged.
